venta.faq.texto: What safety managers usually ask before a pilot.
venta.faq.1.r: Meta Quest 3 headsets that your company buys or rents. Catalogue scenarios also open in the browser of a phone or a PC.
venta.faq.2.p: Does it work without internet on site?
venta.faq.2.r: Yes. The apps and scenarios run offline, keep the signed session and send it once the network is back.
venta.faq.3.p: Does the company see each worker’s score?
venta.faq.3.r: No. The company sees the certified competence and when it expires. Scores and answers stay in the session record.
venta.faq.4.r: A licensed safety specialist signs every version of every scenario, with the standard and the date.
venta.faq.6.p: Can you build a simulator for our hazard?
venta.faq.6.r: Yes. A custom native simulator costs USD 5,000 to 15,000, depending on the hazard and the machinery, and it connects to the platform.
